policy: Resolve punctuation/compact droid identifiers before thresholding. Keep named characters distinct from relatives or same-person alternate identities when the game key encodes a specific redeemed/outfit state. Treat DLC costume variants as separate digital appearance states and do not substitute ordinary physical versions without exact outfit evidence.

physical_status.brickipedia_status: video-game-only minifigure; never existed in physical form or an official LEGO set

rejected_top_candidate.reason: similar compact droid identifier but a different character

records.reason: ME-8D9 is a distinct protocol droid represented in LEGO Star Wars video games. Brickipedia explicitly classifies the LEGO minifigure as video-game-only and nonphysical. The resolver's EV-9D9 lead is an identifier-shape false positive.

Aftab Ackbar is a separate named Resistance character, not an outfit variant of Admiral Ackbar. Brickipedia's video-game-only listings include Aftab among nonphysical Resistance minifigures. Family-name/species similarity must not collapse father and son.

related_physical_family.subject: Kylo Ren
related_physical_family.status: same person but earlier/dark-side identity and different outfit/state

records.reason: The Skywalker Saga exposes Ben Solo as a distinct playable redeemed state, and Brickipedia separates that digital variant within Kylo Ren's game gallery. Physical Kylo Ren minifigures establish the same person's broader family but are not exact state/outfit equivalents. Contemporary LEGO collecting coverage continued to note the absence of an official redeemed Ben Solo minifigure.

source_context.pack: LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga Summer Vacation Character Pack

physical_status.note: ordinary, holiday-sweater, Episode IX, and other Emperor Palpatine physical variants are separate designs

records.reason: The official Summer Vacation DLC explicitly includes The Emperor in beach wear. Current Palpatine minifigure catalogs list multiple ordinary and novelty physical variants but no matching beach/swimsuit Emperor. The source key therefore encodes a digital DLC costume state rather than a generic Emperor identity.

transformations: zero/letter-O normalization in canonical droid identifier

rejected_top_candidate.reason: compact identifier similarity only; wrong droid

records.reason: Brickset catalogs D-O as sw1051 beginning in 2019, before The Skywalker Saga. The source key uses D-0 with a zero while the canonical/catalog name uses D-O with the letter O, causing the resolver to miss the exact physical subject and rank unrelated compact droid names instead.

systemic_findings: Compact droid identifiers need canonical zero/O and punctuation normalization before lexical similarity scoring.
Shared surnames and close family relationships are not identity equivalence.
Same-person aliases such as Kylo Ren and Ben Solo still require story-state/outfit matching before exact physical equivalence.
DLC costume keys such as EmperorBeach must be evaluated as exact digital outfit states rather than collapsed to the base character.
